The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee
statement.)

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight rate) at
its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

The domestic economy seems likely to maintain its upward
trend.

While investment exhibits a slowdown in its pace of
expansion, exports continue to post robust growth and private
consumption shows a steady increase.

There is, however, a high
degree of uncertainty surrounding future economic developments,
largely due to the run-up in international oil prices and the
prolonged international financial market unrest.

Consumer price inflation has picked up its pace, mainly
influenced by high oil prices.

The upward trend of real estate prices
has flattened out.

In the financial markets, there is ample liquidity and financial
institutions' lending continues to show a steady increase.

Meanwhile,
financial market price variables have shown increased volatility,
mainly affected by the international financial market unrest.
